title: Equal Row and Column Pairs
description: Given an `n x n` integer grid, count ordered pairs `(r,c)` such that row `r` and column `c` contain exactly the same sequence of values. Repeated equal rows or columns count as separate pairs. Input: square `grid`. Output: the pair count.
hints: Check each cell using its row and column relationships.
Handle single-row, single-column, tie, and center-cell cases explicitly.
